_note: Features shown as locked in the app and listed on the landing page. 'status' is how they are announced: 'Beta' (part of it works today) or 'Rolling out later' (not started). Plan names and prices are placeholders until pricing is decided. 'why' explains the real limit, so it can be checked later.

locked.title: Bulk upload
locked.description: Upload a CSV of prospects and research them in one batch.
locked.why: Each prospect costs model and source requests. A batch of 100 would run for hours on the free request limit.

locked.title: Send from your mailbox
locked.description: Create the approved email in your Gmail or Outlook, ready for you to send.
locked.why: Needs a connected Google or Microsoft account and a verified app, which costs time and an account of its own.
locked.today: Open in Gmail works today: the draft opens in Gmail compose, formatted and addressed. Sending straight from your connected mailbox comes next.

locked.title: Suggested prospects
locked.description: Get suggestions for companies similar to the ones you research, drawn from the accounts list.
locked.why: Search across accounts is free and local (lib/search.ts). Suggestions need a larger accounts list and a ranking step that has not been built.
locked.today: Local account search works today. Suggestions built on top of it come next.

locked.title: CRM sync
locked.description: Push accounts and approved emails to your CRM.
locked.why: Needs a paid CRM connection for each customer.

locked.title: Team sharing
locked.description: Share runs, templates and the Outbox with your team.
locked.why: Needs accounts and access control. The app has one user today.
